layouts.name: MC Motorsport Main Track
layouts.description: The historical main training circuit retains the narrow northern teardrop, central western return and inner hairpin, long parallel southwestern legs and southern U-turn. Independent anonymous public OSM GPS spatial samples corroborate the main-course pavement location in the January 5, 2026 Sentinel-2 raster and distinguish it from the unrelated northern training pad and larger western skidpan branches. The unordered points are not reconstructed as a driving trip. The earlier rejected outlines selected the wrong western and northern pavement; those outlines remain excluded. Native 10 m imagery and unverified GPS accuracy leave fine corner radii and historical alignment draft. All pixel vertices come from this independently georeferenced public raster; no supplied diagram is digitized or georeferenced. The 2016 organizer sprint uses additional skidpan branches and is not substituted for the supplied main-track configuration. Public GPS mapping points support course-branch identification only; no GPS coordinates are imported or redistributed. Identification inspection metadata: public-gps-identification-review.json, SHA-256 78fdf59abeeb70cd6cfad19487c0be4a0f8f65cb01cd797d870b50546341bc40. Geometry is independently digitized from the licensed georeferenced raster, not from the GPS samples. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1524.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.title: Public mapping course identification
sources.evidenceNote: Legacy and current GPS uploads have date-dependent CC-BY-SA and ODbL terms, while these anonymous sample dates are unavailable. GPS coordinates are not imported or redistributed. The public spatial overlay supplies course-branch identification only; geometry is separately digitized from the independently georeferenced licensed Copernicus raster. The unordered samples are never interpreted as an ordered trip, lap or timing trace. Inspection metadata hash 78fdf59abeeb70cd6cfad19487c0be4a0f8f65cb01cd797d870b50546341bc40. Rights evidence: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Licensing_Working_Group/Minutes/2024-10-07.
